reports.title: PROCEPT BioRobotics Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Reaffirms 2026 Financial Guidance

guidance.heading: Full Year 2026 Financial Guidance
section: •The Company reiterates revenue for the full year 2026 to be in the range of $390 million to $410 million, which represents growth of 27% to 33% compared to the prior year period
•The Company reiterates U.S. procedure volume for the full year 2026 to be in the range of 54,000-56,000 which represents growth of 25% to 29% compared to the prior year period
•The Company reiterates gross margin for the full year 2026 to be approximately 65%
•The Company reiterates adjusted EBITDA* loss for the full year 2026 to be in the range of $35 million to $30 million

*Adjusted EBITDA is a financial measure that is not prepared in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles in the United States (GAAP). For more information about the Company’s use of non-GAAP financial measures, please see the section below titled “Use of Non-GAAP Financial Measures (Unaudited).
